svg.title: Two routes close and policy narrows
svg.desc: Show two individually blocked routes plus a narrower surviving policy gate. Concrete mitigation must be visible before the narrative asks what conditions it left unchanged. Visual distinction: A sieve with one narrow allowed aperture and stopped alternative lanes. Shows a reduced request surface without claiming all access is blocked.
